unit.why: A short anecdote: a villager who lost everything in a fire comes to the Maggid of Kozienice, who explains the misfortune through a notarikon on 'ויטע אשל'.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי איך שבא בן כפר אחד
stories.summary_en: A villager complains to the Maggid of Kozienice that despite his hospitality his property burned down. The Maggid explains that by the notarikon of אשל (eating, drinking, escorting, lodging) he kept only eating and drinking and neglected lodging and escorting. So the ל was missing and only אש (fire) remained.
